cash-snap.name: Banknote snap
cash-snap.description: One sharp paper flick, a short rustle, then a soft stack landing. No melody.

cash-riffle.name: Cash fan
cash-riffle.description: A fast six-note paper riffle closing with a rubber-band snap. A longer, textured motion.

ammo-chamber.name: Chamber click
ammo-chamber.description: Two tight mechanical clicks, followed by one small brass ring. Compact and dry.

ammo-spill.name: Cartridge scatter
ammo-spill.description: Three uneven brass collisions, descending in weight. Metallic, without a pitched reward tune.

knife-draw.name: Blade draw
knife-draw.description: A rising air swipe into one sustained steel ring. Smooth and bright.

knife-cut.name: Hard slice
knife-cut.description: A short cutting swish with a blunt stop and a tiny blade tick. Much drier than Blade draw.

duffel-drop.name: Loaded bag drop
duffel-drop.description: One low padded impact, followed by fabric movement. Weight without a musical ping.

duffel-zip.name: Zip and cash
duffel-zip.description: A short zipper rasp, then a banknote flap. A textured opening motion instead of a bass hit.

diamond-prism.name: Prism ring
diamond-prism.description: One high glass strike with a clear, lingering shimmer. No sequence of reward notes.

diamond-spark.name: Crystal sparkle
diamond-spark.description: Four tiny glass flecks sweep upward, ending in a higher crystal ping. Light and airy.

brass-punch.name: Knuckle impact
brass-punch.description: One midrange punch with a low body and a very short metal edge. No ringing tail.

brass-clang.name: Heavy brass clang
brass-clang.description: A hard, resonant metal strike over a low drop. Rings longer and feels hollow.

bike-rev.name: Throttle blip
bike-rev.description: One short engine rev rising and releasing. Gritty pulses, no chime.

bike-launch.name: Launch and skid
bike-launch.description: A longer accelerating engine with a brief high tyre squeal at the exit.

truck-latch.name: Armored latch
truck-latch.description: Two heavy metal lock clicks with a short door-body thump.

radio-chirp.name: Radio dispatch chirp
radio-chirp.description: A pair of short radio tones ending in a dry static cut. Electronic, without an engine impact.

reel-motor.name: Reel motor kick
reel-motor.description: A brief low motor rise and a dry latch at the start of movement.

reel-air.name: Reel air pull
reel-air.description: A clean sucked-air sweep followed by a small tick. Lighter and less mechanical.

scatter-call.name: Incoming call
scatter-call.description: Two rounded telephone-style tones with a tiny electronic pop. Clear symbol identity.

scatter-metal.name: Scatter stamp
scatter-metal.description: A single heavy latch and a short bright metal ring. No phone tones.

rotor.name: Rotor pass
rotor.description: A pulsing low rotor bed with a rising filtered wind texture. A 1.8-second audition.

siren.name: Police two-tone
siren.description: A sustained alternating siren sweep with a quiet low motor underneath. A 1.8-second audition.

reward-coins.name: Coin tumble
reward-coins.description: Five scattered metallic coin strikes followed by one resolved bright bell. Irregular physical rhythm.

reward-brass.name: Heist stamp
reward-brass.description: One warm brass chord and a low punch. A single bold hit with no coin or arpeggio sequence.

counter-paper.name: Paper roller
counter-paper.description: Fast irregular paper flicks with a short stack tap at the end. A 1.5-second preview.

counter-metal.name: Mechanical ticker
counter-metal.description: Even dry metal ticks, slightly accelerating, with a closing register clack. A 1.5-second preview.

fuse-sparks.name: Spark fuse
fuse-sparks.description: Continuous fine hiss with sharp, irregular tiny sparks. Two-second preview; no melody.

fuse-grit.name: Coarse fuse
fuse-grit.description: A lower gritty burn, with a small sputter every quarter second. Two-second preview.

ui-soft.name: Soft UI pop
ui-soft.description: A single rounded pop with a quick pitch drop. Short and non-metallic.

ui-click.name: Switch click
ui-click.description: One dry, high mechanical click with no pitched tail.

impact-sub.name: Sub impact
impact-sub.description: One deep thump with a broad noise crack. Low and short.

impact-metal.name: Metal slam
impact-metal.description: A sharper steel impact with a resonant ringing tail. Bright and longer.

move-silk.name: Silk sweep
move-silk.description: A smooth rising air sweep. No impact or pitched reward notes.

move-zip.name: Electric zip
move-zip.description: A sharply rising electronic glide with a thin scratch. Short, synthetic and pointed.

rise-tremolo.name: Pulsing charge
rise-tremolo.description: Five tightening low pulses followed by a bright rise. Rhythmic rather than a sustained sweep.

rise-air.name: Air swell
rise-air.description: One continuous rising wash over a low tone. Smooth, with no repeated pulses.

end-dry.name: Dry stop
end-dry.description: A neutral low stop tick. No sad melody or celebratory notes.

end-fall.name: Power-down
end-fall.description: One short descending electronic glide, ending cleanly.

star-lock.name: Star lock
star-lock.description: A mechanical click and a short bright harmonic ring. One compact event.

star-chord.name: Star chord
star-chord.description: A rounded three-note chord struck at once, without a mechanical click.
